name: French 规模与账面价值公开只买入分组
scope: author-defined US equities USD monthly realized returns

definition.formula: Source book equity divided by prior December market equity; June annual sort; not OSAP tangible book; L/N/H are source value-weighted monthly portfolio returns; B=(L+N+H)/3 within size
definition.direction: source high-score is H; realized comparison only
definition.transforms: source percent / 100 once; no RF subtraction or sign inversion

input.price_basis: official research portfolio returns; not ETF execution prices

universe: French source-defined changing US stock groups; six portfolios by size and signal; not a local historical stock panel

time.available_at: unknown historical release time, download not historical availability

validation.method: published rows/strict parser and independent unit checks

construction: Source book equity divided by prior December market equity; June annual sort; not OSAP tangible book
inputs: official Average Value Weighted Returns -- Monthly
historical_availability: published retrospective CRSP 202608/CIZ reconstruction; PIT arrival and revisions not locally audited
missing_policy: reject -99.99/-999, duplicate or missing selected month; no fill
preprocessing: divide source percent once; no sign multiplier or RF subtraction
questions: published high-score buy group versus source-matched all-groups and middle group
local_changes: B is equal capital across three source groups within size; official source group weighting unchanged
license_status: official publicly accessible; full source redistribution not established

output_fields.B: arithmetic mean of three group returns
output_fields.counts: number of stocks per original group

source.read_scope: official CSV header, current library CIZ notice, official OP and momentum construction pages
